Observation & Questions

Learning Objectives

Science Practice:

Asking questions and defining problems based on observations of leaf structure and function

Core Ideas:

Structure and function relationships in biological systems at the cellular and molecular level

Crosscutting Concepts:

Patterns in nature and the relationship between structure and function

Your Investigation

Instructions

Examine the leaf samples provided and record your initial observations. Focus on both visible structures and any patterns you notice. Then, generate at least three scientific questions based on what you observe.
